jamal: Heads-up: after the EU-WEST-3 BIOS+BMC roll last night a subset of OOB consoles are flapping and we've started evicting GPUs from the compute pool. provisioning backlog building.
maria: saw that, checking canaries. any pattern on chassis/psu or NICs?
jamal: looks correlated to a particular BMC firmware build (v2.3.7->v2.3.8) and a watchdog change. consoles intermittently drop remote-console session and trigger host reboot.
alex: opened a k8s node alert for CPU/gpu eviction spikes. tokenized logs show repeated watchdog resets on nodes 208-215.
jamal: pasting serial excerpt from node208: ```
[2026-02-14T04:12:01Z] BMC: WATCHDOG_RESET reason=oom-kill, reboot_count=3
[2026-02-14T04:12:03Z] BIOS: secureboot toggle detected: flag=0x1 -> 0x0
[2026-02-14T04:12:05Z] OOB: session closed, ip=10.2.4.208
```
maria: secureboot toggling during power state transition — odd. could be a BIOS microcode edge-case with the new BMC watchdog timing.
lucy: is this impacting Dedicated/reserved pools? customer-facing jobs?
jamal: yes, eu-west-3-gpu pool lost ~6 nodes -> autoscaler pulled fallback in eu-west-1. fallback capacity is nearly saturated; cost for the last hour spiked ~+42% compared to baseline.
sre-bot: @channel incident created: IN-1764512345 - oob-console-flap -> provisioning backlog. Severity: P2. Linked runbook: infra-runbook-bot/check-oob-watchdog
infra-runbook-bot: runbook step 1: roll BMC to previous stable build v2.3.7 on affected racks. run `oobctl rollback --rack 8-9 --image v2.3.7 --force` and monitor <10m.
alex: starting rollback on rack 8. status shows mixed states:
```
rack 8: node208:BMC(v2.3.8, flapping)
       node209:BMC(v2.3.7, stable)
       node210:BMC(v2.3.8, flapping)
```
maria: quick check: any TPM/KMS errors in attestation/audit? secureboot flips could be attestation failing and triggering policy fallback.
jamal: grep from attest.log -> node208: `NV_RAM_CRC_MISMATCH` then `ATTESTATION_POLICY_FALLBACK`. repeating.
lucy: customers pinging: need ETA. what timeline?
maria: rollback + reprovision + drain/join takes ~2-3h if rollback goes clean.
jamal: temporary mitigation: disabled aggressive eviction in scheduler (raised eviction threshold) and bumped eu-west-3 GPU pool min nodes to hold capacity. this reduces immediate impact but increases spend.
alex: note: disabling auto-evict defers remediation. we should run a manual cordon/inspect sweep for nodes with >3 WATCHDOG_RESET in 10m.
lucy: pls post a short customer note for eu-west-3: "Transient node rebalances in eu-west-3; we are rolling back a BMC firmware and provisioning additional capacity. Expect temporary latency increases for reserved pools. Contact support if SLA is impacted."
sre-bot: update: rollback command issued for rack 8 at 1765439999, monitoring.
jamal: rollback applied to node209/210 OK, node208 entered BMC_REBOOT_LOOP and is not accepting oobctl commands. opened OEM ticket for FRU diagnostics (case#OEM-4821).
maria: for short-term: can we pin secureboot enforcement off during reprovision for affected nodes to avoid flip-triggered evictions? need approval from security.
jamal: raised a temporary exemption with security: "eu-west-3 oob rollback window" for reprovision actions only.
alex: logs show a pattern: when BMC watchdog interval shortened <6s it races with BIOS microcode legacy sleep, causing NV RAM CRC churn. probable root cause.
maria: action items: 1) roll affected racks to v2.3.7 (done for some) 2) OEM FRU swap for node208 3) add BMC preflight check for secureboot flag stability in update pipeline (RFC) 4) update runbook to include immediate cordon sweep when WATCHDOG_RESET >2 within 15m.
jamal: created RFC-ops/2026-02-bmc-preflight: "prevent secureboot flag transitions during BMC updates" and assigned eng-firmware + eng-infra.
lucy: support note posted. finance asked for cost delta breakdown — alex can you drop the hourly delta and nodes spun in slack-costs?
alex: will post cost breakout in #finance after this thread. initial estimate: ~3h at +42% for this pool, added cross-region egress + spot fallback churn.
maria: after rollback completes, we'll run a controlled canary (rack 9 only) with extended watch timeout before further rollouts.
jamal: final: keep monitoring OOB sessions, cordon any node with repeated WATCHDOG_RESET, OEM case open for node208, runbook updated.
__metadata: generated: scenario-based slack thread for infra event about BMC/BIOS roll causing oob console flaps, evictions, rollback and cost spike
